text:
sarah_sales: Heads up — Stratus wants a staging environment for a POC. Need a dedicated GPU pool accessible to their engineers. Target load: ~600 req/min peak, avg ~200. Latency goal ~100-200ms. Prefer region us-west2.
eli_infra: Quick q — will they use streaming or short completions? That changes optimal SKU and batching.
sarah_sales: Mostly short completions + embeddings. Typical prompt ~200 tokens in, ~150 tokens out. Expect ~3-4 concurrent sessions per user, ~50 users in burst.
maria_solutions: For that profile I'd recommend 4x A100-80GB or 2x H100-80GB if they want extra headroom. H100 is ~2x cost but lower p99 latency for larger contexts. Note: H100 availability in us-west2 is more limited right now.
eli_infra: +1 on 4x A100. Also enable KV/response caching and set batching config max_batch=64. If embeddings are heavy, consider a separate embedding pool to avoid contention.
sarah_sales: Budget is a concern — can we get a ballpark monthly cost for a 30d POC on both options? Also they need tenant-scoped API keys for 2 SEs and console access. Any blockers if we keep it hosted (no VPC)?
maria_solutions: Rough ballpark: 4x A100 reserved for 30d + infra overhead ≈ $48k. H100 option ≈ $85k. I'll refine the quote. We can issue temporary API keys scoped to the tenant (TTL 30d) and invite SEs to Console via SSO. Hosted Dedicated pool (no VPC) is the fastest path.
eli_infra: For VPC/private: expect network peering + config lead time ≈ 5 business days. Hosted dedicated pool provisioning timeline typically 48–72h once we have tenant/billing info.
sarah_sales: Hosted is fine for the POC. 48–72h works. What do you need from me to kick off?
maria_solutions: I'll open the provisioning ticket. Please provide: customer tenant name, billing contact, preferred start date, and SE emails. Also confirm region=us-west2 and sku=A100-80GB (unless you want H100).
sarah_sales: Tenant: stratus-inc. Billing contact: finance@stratus.com. Preferred start: ~2 weeks from now. SEs: alan@stratus.com, jen@stratus.com. Confirm region us-west2. Go with A100 for now.
eli_infra: Noted. I'll tentatively reserve capacity. Suggest adding an autoscale burst to 6 vGPUs for short spikes (15m windows) — low incremental cost but avoids throttles.
sarah_sales: Add the autoscale burst please. They also asked about SLA for POC — what's realistic?
maria_solutions: POC gets best-effort. If they want an SLA, we can offer Dedicated with SLA add-on at 99.5% for an extra fee; include that as an option in the quote.
eli_infra: Sample pool config I'll use for the ticket:
```
pool_size: 4
sku: "A100-80GB"
region: "us-west2"
autoscale:
  burst_to: 6
ttl_days: 30
tenant: "stratus-inc"
```
maria_solutions: I'll capture both cost options (A100 vs H100) and a checklist: tenant ID, billing contact, SE emails, preferred start, VPC? (no), SSO domain. @deploy-bot can you create the provisioning job draft?
deploy-bot: provisioning workflow created: job_id=prov-7892; status=queued; eta=72h. Assigned: eli_infra.
eli_infra: I'll follow up with infra owners and lock the reservation. @maria_solutions please add an H100 fallback option in case availability frees up.
maria_solutions: Will add fallback and finalize quote. Sarah — I'll send updated quote + checklist by EOD.
sarah_sales: Thanks team :thumbsup:
